notes.title: Sales and Visibility
notes.notes:
Firstly, thank you to everyone who has played Wallrunners! The game is now on sale!

I'm doing a little experiment to see if I can get Wallrunners a little more visibility. I've put the game on sale and I've also added numerous appropriate searchable tags. Hopefully now it will pop up more often when people use Steam's search engine.

What else can I do to increase visibility? Hmm.

notes.title: It's out!
notes.notes: Thanks, everyone who has been following me! Enjoy Wallrunners!

notes.title: Coming Very Soon
notes.notes:
A while ago I said that the game would probably be released on the 20th of June. It is now the 20th of July and the game isn't out. Sorry about that.

Huge progress is being made and I'm really proud of what we've got so far. We will most likely have the game ready and released some time in August.

Thank you so much for your continued support and interest in my first game.

https://www.youtube.com/c/PsychorGames

notes.title: Soft Release Date
notes.notes:
June 20 is the projected release date, but may change depending on circumstances.

Just this week we've acquired some more music for the game and I have completed some of the final art. I expect we'll have all art assets completed and finalized by the end of the month!

Thank you all for the feedback and support you've given me on this journey making my first game!

https://www.youtube.com/c/PsychorGames
